issues.description: Duplicate 'transcriber_error' entry in the message_type tuple is dead data
issues.detail: The tuple lists 'transcriber_error' twice. Tuples-as-sets is already the wrong data structure here; the duplicate proves it. A set literal would have caught this at write-time, and the data shape would make the algorithm (membership test) self-evident.

issues.description: Error-type list is data masquerading as control flow
issues.detail: Fourteen error strings inlined into an elif branch is the wrong data structure. Lift them to a module-level frozenset (ERROR_MESSAGE_TYPES) at the top of the file. The algorithm — 'if message_type in ERROR_MESSAGE_TYPES' — then becomes obvious, the duplicate disappears, and new error codes are a one-line data edit, not a code edit.

issues.description: Merging _process_messages back into _receive_messages is the right call
issues.detail: The two-method split with a try/except wrapper was framework-shaped where a filter would do. Collapsing it to one async-for over the websocket is smaller, more obvious, and removes the swallowing except that caused the loop wedge. Good simplification — leave it alone.

Previous code logged distinct messages for auth/quota errors before pushing the frame. The unified branch only push_errors and drops the logger.error call. Cheap to restore one logger.error line with message_type for operability; small cost, real diagnostic value.
'\ No newline at end of file' on 3233.fixed.md. Trivial; fix the data hygiene so downstream concatenation tools behave.

review.summary: The fix is correctly shaped: the prior _process_messages/_receive_messages split wrapped the inner loop in a try/except that masked disconnect signals and produced the reconnect wedge. Collapsing to a single async-for is smaller and more obvious — TOO-MUCH-FRAMEWORK removed. The error-type handling, however, is WRONG-DATA-STRUCTURE: a fourteen-element tuple inlined in an elif, with a duplicated 'transcriber_error' entry already proving the point. Lift the error message types into a module-level frozenset and the membership test becomes self-evident, the duplicate vanishes, and additions are data edits. Otherwise SMALL-AND-COMPOSABLE.
